DiagnosticMemoryDestina-
tion.clearDtcLimitation
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04117
⌈
If the optional parameter
DiagnosticMemoryDestination.clearDtcLimita-
tion
is not configured, the DM shall use a default value of
allSupportedDtcs
